entry: This year has been about refinement. Less chasing novelty, more polishing what already works. Built steadier habits around sleep, writing, and exercise—even if imperfect, they feel repeatable. Work shifted from firefighting to shaping, and the calmer pace is noticeable. I’m ending the year with fewer dramatic stories but more confidence that I can keep this going.

A year of change and experimentation. Switched roles mid-year, learned new stacks, and traveled more than expected. Plenty of rough edges, but the uncertainty sparked growth and a clearer sense of direction. Looking back, the constant context switching was exhausting, yet it exposed what I actually enjoy doing.

Foundation year. Laid down core routines, shipped a couple of notable projects, and reconnected with old friends. Not flashy, but it set up everything that followed. Learned how much calmer life feels when the basics stay consistent.
